DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 支払いを求めるメッセージを相談したいです。保存画像に、別の友人の冗談の文も混ざっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 不審請求保存画像に別友人冗談混在を先に申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like advice about a message demanding payment. The saved image also includes a joking message from a different friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: First explain that the saved image of a suspicious payment demand also contains a different friend's joke. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ相手からのやり取りではないのですね。原の会話を分けて示せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: So these aren't exchanges with the same person. Can you show the original conversations separately?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。知らない相手の請求と、友人との会話を続けて画像にしたので、同じ相手に見えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 請求未知相手と友人会話を一画像へ連続保存したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I made one continuous image of the demand from someone I don't know and my conversation with a friend, so they look like the same person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you saved the stranger's demand and your friend's conversation consecutively in one image. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 相手と会話の区切りを担当へ説明してください。編集してつなげた画像だけでは判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please explain to the staff member who each person is and where the conversations separate. We can't judge from an edited, joined image alone.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 元の二つの会話を残しています。請求相手に送金したり返信したりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 元二会話保持で請求相手返信送金なしと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I still have both original conversations. I haven't sent money or replied to the person demanding payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Report that you kept both original conversations and neither replied nor sent money to the person demanding payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 現在、相手が近くに来ているなどの状況はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is anything happening now, such as that person coming near you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありません。友人の冗談を請求相手の脅しとして説明することはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 近接危険なしで友人冗談を請求相手脅迫として説明しないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: No. I won't describe my friend's joke as a threat from the person demanding payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that there is no immediate nearby danger and you won't present your friend's joke as the demander's threat. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それぞれの記録を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff member will check each record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 元の会話を相手別に示し、不審請求の部分と友人の別会話を区別して相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 原会話相手別提示で請求部分と友人会話を分離して相談すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll show the original conversations by person and seek advice while distinguishing the suspicious demand from the separate conversation with my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you'll show the originals by person, separating the demand from your friend's conversation when seeking advice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。相談担当へおつなぎします。記録はそのまま保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll connect you with the consultation staff. Please keep the records as they are.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家族への荷物です。伝票の余白に自分の体調や近況を書こうと思いましたが、ここに書いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 配送伝票余白へ家族向け体調近況文記載可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: This parcel is for my family. I thought of writing about my health and recent news in the blank space on the shipping slip. May I write it here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may write family news about your health in the shipping slip's blank space. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送用の表示と家族への連絡文を分けましょう。まだ記入していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's keep the shipping details separate from your message to your family. Have you written anything yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。中に手紙を入れ忘れたので、外に書けば読めると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未記入で同封忘れ手紙代わりの外書き案と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I forgot to put a letter inside, so I thought they could read it if I wrote on the outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't written anything and proposed writing outside instead of the forgotten enclosed letter. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 外側の表示は配送で見える情報です。家族だけに伝えたい内容なら、別の方法を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The outside label contains information visible during delivery. If it's something only your family should know, please choose another way.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 体調の話は外へ書かず、手紙として中へ入れたいです。荷物はまだ封をしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 体調外記載を避け未封荷物へ手紙追加を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to put a letter inside rather than write about my health outside. I haven't sealed the parcel yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to add a letter to the unsealed parcel instead of writing health details outside. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 内容と取扱いを確認してから梱包できます。配送の宛先は用意できていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can pack it after checking the contents and handling requirements. Do you have the delivery address ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 住所と名前は確認済みです。手紙の文で宛名欄が隠れないよう、外には配送情報だけ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先確認済みで連絡文が宛名を覆わず配送情報のみ外記載と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've checked the address and name. I'll write only shipping information outside so the letter's message doesn't cover the address field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you've checked the destination and will put only shipping details outside without covering the address with your message. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。中に入れる物は必要に応じて担当へお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please tell the staff what you're putting inside as necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族向けの近況は手紙にし、外側は宛先の表示として分けて準備します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族向け手紙と外配送表示を分けて準備すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll prepare the news for my family as a letter, separately from the destination label outside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll prepare the family letter separately from the outside shipping label. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。梱包できましたらお声がけください。ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please let us know when it's packed. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃の控えに今月とメモを足しました。でも印刷の日付は先月です。今月の支払いを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先月家賃控えへ今月メモ追記したため今月支払照会を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I added a note saying “this month” to my rent receipt, but the printed date is last month. I'd like to check this month's payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check this month's rent payment because you added a “this month” note to last month's receipt. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのメモはご本人が後で書いたのですか。今月も振込操作をしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you write that note yourself afterward? Did you make a bank transfer this month too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: メモは私が書きました。今月送ったか覚えておらず、前の控えに書けば確認になると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人追記で当月実行記憶なし・旧控え記載で確認になる誤認を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I wrote the note. I don't remember whether I sent it this month and thought writing on the old receipt would serve as confirmation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you added the note yourself, don't remember this month's transfer, and mistakenly thought writing on the old receipt confirmed it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 手書きのメモで元の取引が別の月になるわけではありません。実際の履歴を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: A handwritten note doesn't move the original transaction to a different month. Let's check the actual history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先月の控えを今月の支払証明として使わず、今月の取引があるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 旧控えを今月証明とせず当月実取引有無照会を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I won't use last month's receipt as proof of this month's payment. I'll ask whether there is a transaction this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check whether this month's transaction exists, without treating the old receipt as this month's proof. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が照会方法をご案内します。未確認のまま同じ支払いをやり直さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will explain how to inquire. Please don't repeat the same payment before checking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二重に送らないよう、履歴の確認が終わるまで振込操作を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 履歴確認前の再送金を待ち二重送金を避けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait until the history has been checked before making a transfer, to avoid sending it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you'll wait to transfer again until the history is checked, avoiding double payment. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。確認結果を見てから必要な対応を相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. You can discuss the necessary action after seeing the result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 本人メモと印刷の日付を分け、今月の履歴を確認してから家賃の対応を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手書きと元印刷日区別し当月履歴確認後支払判断を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll distinguish my note from the printed date and decide what to do about the rent after checking this month's history.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll distinguish handwriting from the original printed date and decide about payment after checking this month's history. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。照会担当へご案内します。控えはそのままお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the inquiry staff. Please bring the receipt as it is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: レシートに三百とありますが、現金のおつりがその額ではありません。どの欄か確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: レシート三百と返却現金不一致として表示欄確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The receipt says three hundred, but that isn't the amount of cash change. I'd like to check which field it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check the receipt field because “three hundred” doesn't match the cash returned. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 三百の横の表示を見せてください。お支払いは現金でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please show me the label beside three hundred. Did you pay in cash?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現金です。三百の横はポイントと書いてあります。おつりの数字だと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金払で三百横ポイントをおつりと誤認したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: In cash. It says “points” beside three hundred. I thought it was the change amount.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you paid cash and mistook the three hundred beside “points” for change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それはポイントの表示です。現金の預り額とおつりは別の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: That's the points display. The cash received and change are in separate fields.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらのおつり欄を見ます。ポイントを現金三百円もらう意味とは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 現金おつり欄へ見直しポイントを現金三百円返却としないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll look at this change field. I won't take the points to mean I'm receiving three hundred yen in cash.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the cash change field and won't interpret points as a three-hundred-yen cash refund. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お渡しした現金と、その欄を確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. You can compare the cash we gave you with that field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: おつりは表示と合っています。ポイントの使い方は別に聞いてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実おつり一致を確認しポイント利用方法を別に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The change matches the display. May I ask separately how to use the points?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the actual change matches, then ask separately how to use points. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 制度の案内をご確認いただけます。今の現金会計とは分けて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can check the program information. I'll explain it separately from this cash transaction.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 現金のおつりは確認できました。ポイント欄は別の制度として案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現金会計確認済みと制度ポイント照会を分けて復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've confirmed the cash change. I'll listen to the explanation of the points field as a separate program.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm separately that the cash transaction is checked and you'd like information about the points program. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ポイントの案内はこちらです。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Here's the points information. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお手伝いしましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子を忘れました。見つけた人向けの紙を、この木に画鋲で留めてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 紛失帽子メモを木へ画鋲掲示可否として尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my hat behind. May I pin a note for whoever finds it to this tree with a thumbtack?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may thumbtack a lost-hat note to the tree. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木に画鋲を使わず、忘れ物の相談を担当へしてください。まだ留めていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the lost-property staff instead of using a thumbtack on the tree. You haven't attached it yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。紙に帽子の色と電話番号を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未留置で帽子色電話番号を紙記入済みと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. I've written the hat's color and my phone number on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you haven't attached it and have written the hat's color and phone number on the paper. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 個人の連絡先を自由に掲示せず、管理者へ相談してください。帽子の特徴は何ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consult management rather than posting personal contact details freely. What are the hat's features?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色で後ろに黄色い留め具があります。電話番号は掲示用ではなく担当への連絡方法として渡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺帽子黄留具を示し電話は公開でなく担当連絡先として渡す希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's navy blue with a yellow fastener at the back. I'd like to give the number to the staff as a way to contact me, rather than post it publicly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the navy hat with a yellow fastener and ask to give the phone number to staff for contact rather than public posting. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 最後に見た場所も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll also ask where you last saw it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 池の手前のベンチです。三十分前に置いたと思いますが、今は見当たりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 池前ベンチ三十分前置いた可能性と現在不在を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: On the bench before the pond. I think I left it there thirty minutes ago, but I can't find it now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you may have left it on the bench before the pond thirty minutes ago and it's missing now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 掲示できるかも含めて担当が取扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will check how to handle this, including whether a notice can be posted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 木に留めず、帽子の特徴と最後の場所を担当へ伝え、連絡先の扱いも相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 木掲示未実施で特徴地点と連絡先取扱いを管理者へ相談すると復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't attach it to the tree. I'll tell the staff the hat's features and last location, and ask how to handle my contact details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that you haven't posted on the tree and will consult management about the features, location and contact details. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。忘れ物担当へご案内します。紙はご自身でお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-05214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to lost property. Please keep the paper with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。駅で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help you with anything at the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 携帯を充電したいです。壁にコンセントがありますが、利用者用か分からないので、つなぐ前に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 未表示コンセントを充電用と決めず接続前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to charge my phone. There's a wall socket, but I don't know whether it's for passengers, so I'd like to ask before plugging in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before connecting, without assuming an unmarked socket is for charging. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの場所のコンセントでしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 待合室の隅です。机は近くにありますが、充電用という表示は見つかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待合室隅の机近くにあるが充電表示未発見と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: In the corner of the waiting room. There's a desk nearby, but I couldn't find a sign saying it's for charging.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it's near a desk in the waiting-room corner but you found no charging sign. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 机が近いだけでは、利用できる設備と判断しないでください。利用できる充電設備があるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please don't assume it's available just because a desk is nearby. I'll check whether there are charging facilities you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。自分の延長コードを出す前に待ちます。通路を横切るように線を伸ばすつもりもありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 延長線を出さず通路を横切らせず案内を待つと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'll wait before taking out my extension cord. I don't intend to run a cable across the passage either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that you'll wait for guidance without taking out an extension cord or running it across the passage. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この待合室では利用者向けの充電場所をご案内していません。別の方法をお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't offer a passenger charging location in this waiting room. Please consider another method.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。持っている予備電池を使います。残りの電力で切符の画面を出せるか、今確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内された充電場所がないため予備電池で切符画面を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'll use the backup battery I have. I'd like to check now whether I can show my ticket screen with the power remaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that since no charging location is available, you'll use your backup battery and check the ticket screen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 切符の提示についてお困りなら、電源がなくなる前に係員へご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have trouble showing your ticket, please speak to a staff member before the battery runs out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 予備電池につないで画面を確認します。必要な提示ができない場合は、壁の電源を使わず係員に相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提示不能なら壁電源を勝手に使わず係員に相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll connect the backup battery and check the screen. If I can't show what's required, I'll consult staff without using the wall socket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask staff if you can't show the ticket, without using the wall power without permission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お困りの際はまたお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please speak to us again if you need help.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。講座の申込みでお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Can I help with course registration?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の講座を申し込みたいです。友人が車で送ってくれますが、参加するのは私だけなので、申込者は一人でよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 送迎の友人は受講しないため講座申込者は一人か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to register for a Japanese course. A friend will drive me here, but only I will attend. Should I list just one applicant?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the course application should be for one person because the friend driving you won't attend. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご友人は講座の席に一緒に座る予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is your friend planning to sit in the course with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、送った後は帰ります。私の説明に二人で来ると書いたので、参加人数も二人と受け取られそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人は送迎後帰り二人来訪説明で二席と誤認されそうと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, they'll go home after dropping me off. I wrote that two of us are coming, so it might be read as two participants.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your friend will leave after dropping you off and “two coming” might be mistaken for two seats. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 参加する人数と送迎の人数を分けて書きましょう。まだ申込みは提出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's write the number attending separately from the number involved in transport. You haven't submitted the application yet, have you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。参加者欄を私一人にして、送迎について必要なら備考で説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未提出で参加者を一人にして必要な送迎事項は備考に分けると答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I'll list only myself in the participant field and explain the transport in the notes if necessary.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that it isn't submitted and you'll list one participant, putting necessary transport details separately in the notes. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 送迎車の出入りについては、別の案内も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please also check the separate guidance on vehicles entering and leaving for drop-off and pickup.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、講座の席を二人分取ることと駐車場所の相談は別にします。友人へも参加者ではないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席確保と駐車相談を分け友人へ非参加を共有すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll separate reserving two course seats from asking about parking. I'll also tell my friend they aren't a participant.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll separate seat reservations from parking inquiries and tell your friend they aren't attending. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加日と連絡先も確認してからご提出ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check the attendance date and contact details before submitting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この日の参加者は私一人です。私の連絡先を書き、友人の車の案内は別に聞いてから提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 参加日と本人連絡先を示し送迎案内は別相談として提出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm the only participant on this date. I'll write my own contact details and submit after asking separately about my friend's car.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State the attendance date and your contact details and submit with transport guidance treated as a separate inquiry. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。申込書を確認しますので、こちらへどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please come this way so we can check the application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付の書類で何かお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having trouble with the reception forms?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 問診の紙を書きましたが、別の紙に同意という欄があります。説明を聞いていないので、同じ署名だと思って書く前に尋ねたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 問診署名と別紙同意欄を同じとせず説明前に尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I've filled in the medical questionnaire, but a separate paper has a consent field. I haven't had an explanation, so I'd like to ask before treating it as the same signature and signing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask before an explanation, without treating the questionnaire signature and separate consent field as the same. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの紙の、どの欄でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの最後の欄です。問診の名前は書きましたが、この内容はまだ十分に読めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 問診の名前は記入済みだが別紙最終欄を十分読めていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: This last field here. I've written my name on the questionnaire, but haven't read this content thoroughly yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you've entered your name on the questionnaire but haven't fully read the separate paper's last field. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 問診の記入と同意の確認を分けて、説明の担当へおつなぎします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll separate filling in the questionnaire from confirming consent and connect you to the person who explains it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。分からない言葉に印を付けました。印があるのは、全部に同意したという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 語句の印は疑問の目印で同意表示ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I've marked words I don't understand. The marks don't mean that I've agreed to everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the marks indicate questions about words, not consent. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 質問したい箇所の目印なのですね。説明を受ける際に、その意味も伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: So they're markers for points you want to ask about. Please explain that when you receive the explanation too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。何をすることへの同意なのか、今署名する必要があるのかを、説明の方へ聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 行為内容と現時点署名必要性を説明担当へ質問したいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'd like to ask the person explaining what I'm consenting to and whether I need to sign now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to ask the explanation staff what action the consent covers and whether signing is needed now. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 説明を聞いて、内容とご自身の意思を確認してから対応してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please listen to the explanation, check the content and your own wishes, then decide what to do.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。問診票は提出し、この紙の分からない箇所は別に質問します。読めないまま署名をそろえません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 問診と質問紙を分け理解前に署名をそろえないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll submit the questionnaire and separately ask about the unclear parts of this paper. I won't sign all the papers without being able to read them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Answer that you'll separate the questionnaire from the paper with questions and won't sign them all before understanding. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。説明担当へご案内しますので、紙をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll direct you to the explanation staff, so please bring the papers.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。ご相談で何かお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your inquiry?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 道であった出来事の場所を伝えたいです。携帯の地図を用意しましたが、ピンが私の家に付いているので、そのまま現場として見せないようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出来事の地図ピンが自宅のため現場として誤提示せず相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to explain where something happened on the street. I've prepared a map on my phone, but its pin marks my home, so I don't want to show it as the incident location as it is.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the map pin marks your home and seek advice without mistakenly presenting it as the incident location. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのピンは、今回の場所を記録した物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does that pin record the location of this incident?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、以前に自宅を保存した印です。画面を開くとそこへ戻るので、出来事の位置だと思われそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ピンは以前の自宅保存で画面初期位置が現場に見えると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, it's a marker I previously saved for my home. The screen returns there when opened, so it could look like the incident location.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the pin is a previously saved home marker and the initial map view could look like the scene. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の場所を、覚えている目印でも説明してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please describe the actual location using landmarks you remember too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 駅から二つ目の信号の交差点です。角に青い看板がありました。自宅の前で起きたわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 駅から二つ目信号と青看板が目印で自宅前ではないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's the intersection at the second traffic light from the station. There was a blue sign on the corner. It didn't happen in front of my home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the second traffic light from the station and blue sign as landmarks, and say it wasn't outside your home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図を動かして、その交差点を確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Can you move the map and check that intersection?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、この辺りです。ただ、どちらの角だったかははっきりしないので、交差点全体を示して説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 交差点は地図で示せるがどの角か未確認と答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, around here. But I'm not sure which corner it was, so I'll indicate the whole intersection and explain.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Answer that you can show the intersection on the map but haven't confirmed which corner. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分からない所まで正確な一点として示す必要はありません。ご自宅からの道順も、現場の範囲とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: You don't need to indicate an exact point where you aren't sure. Please also separate the route from your home from the area of the incident.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自宅のピンは今回の位置に含めません。駅から二つ目の交差点と看板を説明し、角は未確認だと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自宅ピンを除き交差点目印と角不確実を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't include my home pin as this location. I'll describe the second intersection from the station and the sign, and say the corner isn't confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain the intersection landmarks and uncertainty about the corner separately, excluding the home pin. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。その地図と目印を使って、詳しいお話を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll hear the details using that map and those landmarks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便について何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help with your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: さきほど渡した封筒に、説明の紙を一枚入れ忘れました。受付後なので自分で取り戻さず、まだ相談できるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受付済封筒への入れ忘れ紙を自分で取り戻さず追加相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot to put one explanatory sheet in the envelope I handed over earlier. Since it's been accepted, I won't take it back myself; I'd like to ask whether anything can still be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about adding a forgotten sheet to an accepted envelope without retrieving it yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 先ほどの控えはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the receipt from earlier?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、こちらです。封筒を渡してから鞄の中に残った紙に気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えがあり引渡し後鞄の紙に気づいたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, here it is. After handing over the envelope, I noticed the paper left in my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have the receipt and noticed the paper in your bag after handing the envelope over. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の状態を担当が確認します。追加したい紙は、その封筒の宛先への物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check its processing status. Is the paper you want to add for the addressee of that envelope?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、同じ相手への補足です。料金を払った後でも、中身を勝手に入れ替えられるとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同宛先補足だが料金払後も勝手に中身交換可能と思わないと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, it's additional information for the same person. I don't assume I can replace the contents myself even after paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Answer that it's a supplement for the same addressee but you don't assume payment allows you to replace the contents yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状態によってご案内する方法が変わりますので、まず確認をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The method we can offer depends on its status, so please wait for us to check first.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。もし追加できないなら、紙だけ別に送る方法を相談します。前の受付を自分でなかったことにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加不可なら別送を相談し前受付を自己取消にしないと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If it can't be added, I'll ask how to send just the paper separately. I won't treat the earlier acceptance as canceled on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask about separate mailing if adding it isn't possible, without canceling the previous acceptance yourself. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別に送る場合も、相手がどの郵便の補足か分かる説明があるとよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you send it separately, it would help to explain which earlier mailing it supplements.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 先ほどの送付の補足だと書きます。まず控えで状態を確認し、案内された方法で追加か別送かを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 補足関係を明記し受付状態の案内で追加か別送を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write that it supplements the earlier mailing. First I'll have the status checked using the receipt, then decide whether to add it or send it separately by the method advised.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll state the connection to the earlier mailing and decide on adding or separate mailing after guidance on its status. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。控えをお預かりして確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-06205-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll take the receipt and check.
